request_body.raw_goal: Land a job in tech or product management as fast as possible.
request_body.user_context: Just finished NYSC, actively job-hunting. No income yet, living with parents. High urgency — peers are already employed. Has lots of free time to dedicate.

objectives: Develop a specialized technical or product management resume that aligns with industry standard ATS (Applicant Tracking System) criteria.
Master the core competency interview frameworks for tech roles, specifically STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for behavioral and case-study methods for PM roles.
Execute a high-volume, targeted job application strategy focusing on networking and platform-based sourcing.
Build a domain-specific portfolio or case study to demonstrate practical competency in product discovery or technical problem-solving.

proposed_milestones.description: Construct high-conversion application materials tailored for entry-level tech and product roles.
objectives: Audit existing experiences to highlight transferrable skills using the XYZ formula (Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]).
Create a master resume template optimized for ATS parsing to ensure visibility to recruiters.
Draft tailored cover letter templates that map personal background to specific job requirements in product or tech.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish a consistent, high-volume sourcing and referral pipeline.
objectives: Identify and map a list of target companies with active graduate or entry-level cohort programs.
Optimize LinkedIn profile with relevant keywords, a professional summary, and active 'Open to Work' status.
Conduct cold-outreach messaging campaigns to alumni and industry practitioners to request informational interviews.

proposed_milestones.description: Develop and refine mastery of interview delivery and technical problem-solving frameworks.
objectives: Practice mock interview sessions focusing on product sense, technical system design (for tech roles), and prioritization frameworks (for PM roles).
Refine answers to behavioral prompts using the STAR method to ensure conciseness and measurable impact.
Perform peer-reviewed practice rounds or record and review self-performances to eliminate filler words and improve articulation.

proposed_milestones.description: Formalize the application tracking and iteration workflow.
objectives: Maintain a centralized tracker to log every application, recruiter interaction, and follow-up date.
Implement a 'post-mortem' review process after each rejection to identify gaps in resume tailoring or interview performance.
Daily ritual of scraping job boards (LinkedIn, Otta, Wellfound) for new entries within the specific job function.

success_metrics: Average of 10-15 high-quality, targeted applications submitted per week.
Consistent response rate of 10% or higher from cold outreach to target company contacts.
Ability to articulate a product case study or technical problem-solution cycle fluently without relying on notes.
Successful completion of at least 3 recruiter screens or first-round technical interviews within the first 60 days.

request_body.raw_goal: Learn SQL and data analytics properly — I keep seeing it in job listings.
request_body.user_context: Wants to add this skill to strengthen job applications. Frames it as urgent. Already submitted a job-search goal this same session.

objectives: Develop technical proficiency in SQL for relational database querying and data manipulation.
Learn foundational statistical concepts required for descriptive and diagnostic data analysis.
Build competence in data visualization and reporting to communicate analytical findings.
Construct a professional-grade portfolio demonstrating end-to-end data analysis workflows.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish core SQL proficiency through relational schema design and DML command mastery.
objectives: Master SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, and HAVING clauses to query relational datasets.
Practice database normalization and the creation of basic constraints and keys.
Utilize Window Functions and Common Table Expressions (CTEs) for complex data aggregation.

proposed_milestones.description: Transition to data analysis methodology using statistical principles and analytical tools.
objectives: Learn core descriptive statistics: mean, median, mode, standard deviation, and variance.
Implement exploratory data analysis (EDA) techniques to identify data quality issues and outliers.
Practice data cleaning workflows, including handling null values and feature engineering.

proposed_milestones.description: Develop data visualization skills to translate raw metrics into actionable business insights.
objectives: Master visual hierarchy and chart selection principles (e.g., when to use bar, line, or scatter plots).
Create interactive dashboards using tools like Tableau or Power BI to visualize multi-variable datasets.
Practice drafting executive summaries that interpret analytical findings for non-technical stakeholders.

proposed_milestones.description: Synthesize learning into an end-to-end portfolio project for job applications.
objectives: Clean and transform a raw public dataset using SQL to prepare it for analysis.
Perform a multi-stage analysis to answer specific business or research questions.
Document the project workflow and visualizations in a public repository or professional blog.

success_metrics: Successfully execute complex SQL queries involving multiple joins and window functions on a test schema.
Complete one end-to-end data project, from raw data extraction to a published visualization dashboard.
Ability to explain the trade-offs between different SQL join types and analytical chart selections in a mock interview context.
Clear presence of a documented project portfolio accessible to potential employers.

request_body.raw_goal: Build a portfolio project — a data dashboard or product case study — that I can show in interviews.
request_body.user_context: Wants this done ASAP to support job applications. Already submitted job-search and SQL learning goals today.

objectives: Select and clean a relevant dataset to demonstrate data manipulation and analytical proficiency.
Develop a compelling narrative that connects data insights to actionable product or business outcomes.
Implement an interactive visualization dashboard or structured case study deck that adheres to UX/UI best practices for data storytelling.
Optimize portfolio presentation for technical interviewers by focusing on problem definition, methodology, and trade-offs.

proposed_milestones.description: Define the project scope and acquire a dataset suitable for demonstrating analytical rigor and problem-solving.
objectives: Select a domain-relevant dataset (e.g., e-commerce churn, financial metrics, or user behavior) that allows for exploratory data analysis.
Document the problem statement, user personas, and the specific business question the analysis aims to solve.
Perform data cleaning, handling missing values, and outlier detection using Pandas or SQL.

proposed_milestones.description: Execute exploratory data analysis (EDA) and synthesize key findings into a coherent narrative.
objectives: Generate descriptive statistics and identify statistically significant trends or correlations.
Draft the story arc of the project, including the context, methodology, key findings, and final recommendations.
Select appropriate visualization types (e.g., heatmaps, time-series charts, or cohort analysis) that highlight findings clearly.

proposed_milestones.description: Develop the final dashboard or case study artifact using appropriate deployment tools.
objectives: Build the interactive dashboard using tools like Tableau, PowerBI, or Streamlit, ensuring logical flow and responsive layout.
Write the case study summary, ensuring technical trade-offs and decision-making logic are explicitly stated.
Optimize the final artifact for accessibility and clarity of information design.

proposed_milestones.description: Finalize and host the project for recruitment visibility.
objectives: Refactor code or documentation into a clean GitHub repository or portfolio web page.
Create a short (2-minute) pitch script that summarizes the project's impact and the technical challenges overcome.
Review final visuals for alignment with professional standards.

success_metrics: Portfolio project is hosted and accessible via a public URL or GitHub repository.
Case study document explicitly details the problem, data methodology, and business impact.
Dashboard is fully interactive with no broken filters or data connectivity errors.
Project includes a clear 'About' or 'Summary' section that highlights technical stack and analytical approach.
